# Devagotchi

> A local desktop bridge between AI and the workspace. Current workstation execution is a Linux source preview. Task graphs, native Windows/macOS providers, and an internal mesh are in design or planned.

## Public reference

- [Connections](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/connect): HTTP API, reference MCP, and local setup.
- [Capabilities](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/api/v1/capabilities): current machine-readable readiness.
- [Topics](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/api/v1/reference): reference topic index.
- [OpenAPI](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/openapi.json): read-only HTTP API.
- [Local schemas](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/reference/broker-contracts.schema.json): generated snapshot; these are not hosted execution routes.
- [Architecture](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/architecture): existing owners, proposed graph model, mesh semantics, build gates.
- [Research](https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/research): recurring Desktop Commander user reports and resolution evidence.

## MCP

Reference endpoint: https://devagotchi.justsayit.chatgpt.site/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP, protocol 2026-07-28 only, POST with per-request metadata and mirrored headers. Hosted MCP authorization policy applies.
Tools: devagotchi_get_capabilities; devagotchi_get_reference(topic).
These tools read public product reference only. They do not execute commands, access files, connect to a broker, enroll machines, or start a graph.

## Local workstation execution

An installed local MCP host launches `devagotchi mcp` (with --socket ABS_PATH when the broker was started by hand). The independently launched broker owns execution. Four tools: operation_start, operation_get, operation_read, operation_cancel. See the quickstart topic for exact arguments and limits.

The source archive is a Linux developer preview, not an installer. No project license has been selected. No named-host or cross-platform release certification, comparative performance win, or distributed exactly-once guarantee is claimed.

Domain target: devagotchi.net. Use the verified hosted origin above until custom-domain activation is confirmed.
